```{feature ranking barplot}

features_per_fold <- read_csv("Stabl_Data_Outputs/Selected Features STABL Lasso.csv") #this is the early fusion of the late fusion of all untreated omics data

# Step 1: Clean and split strings into list of features
features_long <- features_per_fold %>%
  mutate(feature_list = str_extract_all(`Fold selected features`, "'([^']*)'")) %>%  # extract quoted strings
  mutate(feature_list = lapply(feature_list, function(x) str_remove_all(x, "'"))) %>% # remove the single quotes
  unnest(feature_list)


feature_df <- table(features_long$feature_list)
feature_df  <- as.data.frame(feature_df)
colnames(feature_df) <- c("Feature", "Freq")

#get high frequency only
feature_df <- feature_df[rev(order(feature_df$Freq)),]

feature_df_common <- feature_df[feature_df$Freq >= 20,]

#basic ranking, without survival direction
ggplot(feature_df_common, aes(x = reorder(Feature, Freq), y = Freq)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(title = "Feature Prevalence Across Folds",
       x = "Feature",
       y = "Freq") +
  theme_minimal()

# Load libraries
library(readr)
library(readr)
library(dplyr)

# Load all datasets
data_path <- "Stabl_Data_No_Neoadjuvant"
cna_train <- read_csv(file.path(data_path, "GENOMIC_copy_number_and_rearrangement_counts.csv"))
snv_train <- read_csv(file.path(data_path,  "GENOMIC_mutations_in_10plus_patients.csv")) 
cell_train <- read_csv(file.path(data_path,  "IMC_celltype_densities.csv"))
menv_train <- read_csv(file.path(data_path,  "IMC_microenvironment_densities.csv"))
marker_train <- read_csv(file.path(data_path,  "IMC_marker_intensities.csv"))
clinical_train <- read_csv(file.path(data_path,  "CLINICAL_no_lymph.csv"))
y_train <- read_csv("Stabl_Data_No_Neoadjuvant/Overall_Survival.csv")
  
#make a merged dataset for doing early fusion feature selection
combined <- left_join(snv_train, cell_train)
combined <- left_join(combined, menv_train)
combined <- left_join(combined, cna_train)
combined <- left_join(combined, marker_train)
combined <- left_join(combined, clinical_train)

# Merge all on 'PCSI_ID'
combined_df <- list(snv_train, cell_train, menv_train, cna_train, marker_train, clinical_train, y_train) %>%
  purrr::reduce(left_join, by = "PCSI_ID") %>%
  left_join(y_train, by = "PCSI_ID")

combined_df <- left_join(combined_df, y_train)
# Optional: remove rows with missing outcome
combined_df <- combined_df %>% filter(!is.na(os_cf_binary))

# Separate predictors and outcome
X <- combined_df %>% select(-PCSI_ID, -os_cf_binary)
y <- combined_df$os_cf_binary

# Step: Min-max scale each column between 0 and 1
X_scaled <- X %>%
  mutate(across(everything(), ~ (. - min(., na.rm = TRUE)) / 
                                (max(., na.rm = TRUE) - min(., na.rm = TRUE))))

# Compute mean per feature in each class
bias_df <- X_scaled %>%
  mutate(os_cf_binary = y) %>%
  group_by(os_cf_binary) %>%
  summarise(across(everything(), mean, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  t() %>%
  as.data.frame()

# Set proper names and compute bias
colnames(bias_df) <- c("class_0", "class_1")
bias_df$feature <- rownames(bias_df)
bias_df$bias_toward <- ifelse(bias_df$class_1 > bias_df$class_0, "1", "0")
bias_df$bias_score <- bias_df$class_1 - bias_df$class_0

# Final output
bias_df <- bias_df %>%
  filter(!(feature %in% c("os_cf_binary"))) %>%
  arrange(desc(abs(bias_score)))

#bind and use as colour
feature_df_common <- left_join(feature_df_common, bias_df[c("feature","bias_score")], by = c("Feature" = "feature"))

plot <- ggplot(feature_df_common, aes(x = reorder(Feature, Freq), y = Freq, fill = bias_score)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(title = "",
       x = "Feature",
       y = "Feature Selection Stability",
       fill = "Bias Score") +
  scale_fill_gradient2(low = "red", mid = "white", high = "blue" , midpoint = 0) +
  theme_minimal()
ggsave("Feature_ranked_above20freq_earlyfuse.svg", plot = plot, height = 4, width =6)

```


```{dataset ranking boxplot}

final_pred_0 <- read.csv("Stabl_Data_Outputs/Lasso_predictions/Lasso predictions_All_With_Lymph.csv") #full model with lymph
final_pred_1 <- read.csv("Stabl_Data_Outputs/Lasso_predictions/Lasso predictions_All_Without_Lymph.csv")
final_pred_3 <- read.csv("Stabl_Data_Outputs/Lasso_predictions/Lasso predictions_Genome.csv") #genomics
final_pred_2 <- read.csv("Stabl_Data_Outputs/Lasso_predictions/Lasso predictions_IMC.csv") #imc
final_pred_4 <- read.csv("Stabl_Data_Outputs/Lasso_predictions/Lasso predictions_clinical_with_lymph.csv") #clinical with lymph
final_pred_5 <- read.csv("Stabl_Data_Outputs/Lasso_predictions/Lasso predictions_clinical_without_lymph.csv") #clinical no lymph


library(pROC)
# Common settings
n_boot <- 2000
CI_level <- 0.95
alpha <- (1 - CI_level) / 2
fpr_grid <- seq(0, 1, length.out = 100)

# === Function to compute interpolated mean and CI for a given dataframe ===
get_roc_ci <- function(df, label_col = "os_cf_binary", pred_col = "X0", n_boot = 2000, alpha = 0.025) {
  boot_tprs <- matrix(NA, nrow = n_boot, ncol = length(fpr_grid))
  set.seed(42)
  for (i in 1:n_boot) {
    idx <- sample(1:nrow(df), replace = TRUE)
    y_boot <- df[[label_col]][idx]
    p_boot <- df[[pred_col]][idx]
    roc_obj <- roc(y_boot, p_boot, quiet = TRUE)
    boot_tprs[i, ] <- approx(
      x = 1 - roc_obj$specificities,
      y = roc_obj$sensitivities,
      xout = fpr_grid,
      ties = mean,
      rule = 2
    )$y
  }
  roc_main <- roc(df[[label_col]], df[[pred_col]], quiet = TRUE)
  mean_tpr <- approx(
    x = 1 - roc_main$specificities,
    y = roc_main$sensitivities,
    xout = fpr_grid,
    ties = mean,
    rule = 2
  )$y
  list(
    mean_tpr = mean_tpr,
    ci_lower = apply(boot_tprs, 2, quantile, probs = alpha),
    ci_upper = apply(boot_tprs, 2, quantile, probs = 1 - alpha),
    auc = auc(roc_main)
  )
}

# Compute ROC + CI for both dataframes
roc_0 <- get_roc_ci(final_pred_0)
roc_1 <- get_roc_ci(final_pred_1)
roc_2 <- get_roc_ci(final_pred_2)
roc_3 <- get_roc_ci(final_pred_3)
roc_4 <- get_roc_ci(final_pred_4)
roc_5 <- get_roc_ci(final_pred_5)


#try with dotted lines instead of shading
svg("comparison_roc_curves_with_CI_2026.svg", width = 8, height = 6) 

# Set up blank plot space first
plot(fpr_grid, roc_1$mean_tpr, type = "n",
     xlab = "1 - Specificity", ylab = "Sensitivity",
     main = sprintf("ROC Comparison with %d%% CI", CI_level * 100),
     xlim = c(0, 1), ylim = c(0, 1))

# Function to add ROC + CI as lines
add_roc_with_ci_lines <- function(fpr, roc_obj, col_main, col_ci = col_main) {
  lines(fpr, roc_obj$mean_tpr, lwd = 2, col = col_main)
}

# Plot each ROC + CI
add_roc_with_ci_lines(fpr_grid, roc_0, "orange") 
add_roc_with_ci_lines(fpr_grid, roc_1, "gold") 
add_roc_with_ci_lines(fpr_grid, roc_2, "#C41E3A") 
add_roc_with_ci_lines(fpr_grid, roc_3, "#964B00") 
add_roc_with_ci_lines(fpr_grid, roc_4, "royalblue") 
add_roc_with_ci_lines(fpr_grid, roc_5, "lightblue")

# Diagonal reference line
abline(a = 0, b = 1, lty = 2, col = "gray")

# Legend
legend("bottomright",
       legend = c(sprintf("Full Model with Lymph (AUC = %.3f)", roc_0$auc),
                  sprintf("Full Model without Lymph (AUC = %.3f)", roc_1$auc),
                  sprintf("IMC (AUC = %.3f)", roc_2$auc),
                  sprintf("Genomics (AUC = %.3f)", roc_3$auc),
                  sprintf("Clinical with Lymph (AUC = %.3f)", roc_4$auc),
                  sprintf("Clinical without Lymph (AUC = %.3f)", roc_5$auc)),
       col = c("orange", "gold",  "#C41E3A", "#964B00", "royalblue","lightblue"),
       lwd = 2, bty = "n")

dev.off()


#make a boxplot version
get_roc_ci <- function(df, label_col = "os_cf_binary", pred_col = "X0", n_boot = 2000, alpha = 0.025, return_aucs = TRUE) {
  boot_tprs <- matrix(NA, nrow = n_boot, ncol = length(fpr_grid))
  aucs <- numeric(n_boot)
  set.seed(42)
  for (i in 1:n_boot) {
    idx <- sample(1:nrow(df), replace = TRUE)
    y_boot <- df[[label_col]][idx]
    p_boot <- df[[pred_col]][idx]
    roc_obj <- roc(y_boot, p_boot, quiet = TRUE)
    aucs[i] <- auc(roc_obj)
    boot_tprs[i, ] <- approx(
      x = 1 - roc_obj$specificities,
      y = roc_obj$sensitivities,
      xout = fpr_grid,
      ties = mean,
      rule = 2
    )$y
  }
  roc_main <- roc(df[[label_col]], df[[pred_col]], quiet = TRUE)
  mean_tpr <- approx(
    x = 1 - roc_main$specificities,
    y = roc_main$sensitivities,
    xout = fpr_grid,
    ties = mean,
    rule = 2
  )$y
  return(list(
    mean_tpr = mean_tpr,
    ci_lower = apply(boot_tprs, 2, quantile, probs = alpha),
    ci_upper = apply(boot_tprs, 2, quantile, probs = 1 - alpha),
    auc = auc(roc_main),
    aucs = if (return_aucs) aucs else NULL
  ))
}

# Compute ROC + CI for both dataframes
roc_0 <- get_roc_ci(final_pred_0)
roc_1 <- get_roc_ci(final_pred_1)
roc_2 <- get_roc_ci(final_pred_2)
roc_3 <- get_roc_ci(final_pred_3)
roc_4 <- get_roc_ci(final_pred_4)
roc_5 <- get_roc_ci(final_pred_5)

library(tibble)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

auc_df <- bind_rows(
  tibble(AUC = roc_0$aucs, Model = "Full + Lymph"),
  tibble(AUC = roc_1$aucs, Model = "Full - Lymph"),
  tibble(AUC = roc_2$aucs, Model = "IMC"),
  tibble(AUC = roc_3$aucs, Model = "Genomics"),
  tibble(AUC = roc_4$aucs, Model = "Clinical + Lymph"),
  tibble(AUC = roc_5$aucs, Model = "Clinical - Lymph")
)


means <- auc_df %>% 
  group_by(Model) %>% 
  summarise(mean = mean(AUC))

means <- means[order(means$mean),]

# Reorder the Model factor by mean AUC
auc_df <- auc_df %>%
  mutate(Model = factor(Model, levels = means$Model))


#dataset comparison as boxplots
svg("comparison_roc_curves_boxplot_version_2026.svg", width = 8, height = 6)
ggplot(auc_df, aes(x = Model, y = AUC, fill = Model)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.8, outlier.shape = NA) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.2, size = 0.001, alpha = 0.3, shape = 16) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c( 
    "Full + Lymph" = "orange",
    "Full - Lymph" = "gold",
    "IMC" = "#C41E3A", 
    "Genomics" = "#964B00",
    "Clinical + Lymph" = "royalblue", 
    "Clinical - Lymph" = "lightblue" 
  )) +
  labs(title = "AUC Distributions",
       y = "AUC", x = NULL) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 25, hjust = 1),
        legend.position = "none")
dev.off()

```
